description: This file defines a Perl class 'Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Item' that extends a ResultSet class, providing methods for manipulating 'Item' records in a database, including adding or creating items, calculating preorders, and summing servings.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Item
classes.description: A Perl class representing a database result set for 'Item' entities, with methods to manipulate and query items related to a recipe or shopping list.

methods.name: add_or_create
methods.description: Finds an existing item or creates a new one with specified values, updating its value if it already exists.

methods.name: to_preorder
methods.description: Returns a subset of items that meet preorder criteria based on article servings and workdays.

methods.name: with_servings_sum
methods.description: Calculates and returns the sum of servings related to the items.
